criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Dark field and disciplined accent. 9 the best image, 6 and 8 hold. 7 flat white rings read as a dot chart, Texas label floats, timber overshoots. 5 flat rectangular rods, tread behind the headline, flat tag. 2 generic grey sheet. 1, 3 and 4 dark jack without rim; 4 corrugated bands. Crank motif can't be seen.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One dusk, one material vocabulary, accent on figure frames, camera walk and recurring jack work. Crank motif and sky hue unapplied; 2 and 5 sit slightly outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral checked and traced, ratios and counts right. Looser: the cover equates the lift monitor with a pump jack, the caption drops c28's 'experts and analysts said', the first comment leaks a raw source-type label.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who and what are clear; where is only the Permian and an acreage share; the stake is never stated; the November 17th meeting is a date, not a lever; ends on a question.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover and 2 work, turns at 3 and 8. The middle sags: 4's disclaimer, three figures in a row, 6 cuttable, 8's headline dangles.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: On register and honest. Flat lines: the caption's LLM sentence, 4's not-to-scale disclaimer, a template construction on 2.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh topic; the third quarterly investor document in twelve days, the absence spine, lastLight and a last-light machine opener repeat.

one_sentence_fix: Cut frame 6 for the reader's stake, place Reeves County, and say what the public can do at the November 17th meeting.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat white rings in a grid; floating label; timber overshoot.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Three-quarter view, worn steel joints with a key-side rim, label over its rack.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat bars; tread behind the headline; flat tag.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Round rods with cylindrical couplings, tread only in the lower 55 percent pool, lit brass tag with a cast.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Generic grey ruled sheet in the grey middle.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rake to near white on black steel, enlarge to bleed right, caliche dust and a tailgate edge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Corrugated bands; small jack without rim; block in a void.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Noise bedding, lower closer camera, seam-side rim along the beam.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Cover jack a dark silhouette without an edge.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Key behind toward the seam for a rim, raise the work light on crank and counterweights.
